UPDATE ON SURPLUS:

First, if you're new here, we're building https://t.co/6D1YcYIiD4.

We're an inference provider based on an open market. For high volume buyers, the market prices have been better than the prices you can get anywhere else.

Our median discounts have been 40-60% vs other major inference providers. At a 50% discount, it means 2x as much inference for the same amount of spend.

If you're building an AI product, you should definitely check us out!

----

I'm also building in the open. And this inspired someone to create a coin, $surplus.

The creator is unknown but they gave the trading fees to my twitter account. I used some of the fees to get a few months of runway for a team.

----

Some major work completed by the team last month:

1. Migration to AWS (was completed faster than expected, props to the team).

2. Stripe payment support. Soon after adding this, we saw both; (1) some incremental payment volume, and (2) a shift from crypto to Stripe even though most current users are crypto natives and even though Stripe's fees are high -- both validate the decision to prioritize fiat support.

3. UI revamp. Site looks totally different now; no longer the basic template I made with Claude lol.

----

A few next priorities:

1. Major rework of the orderbook / routing / offer health logic. This is a large chunk of work but will address a lot of feedback we've gotten from both buyers and sellers.

2. Adding support for multi-tenant accounts and more features for business users. This prepares us to onboard business users.

3. Improvements to our media model offerings (image, video, ...).

4. Growth: cold outreach, seo, tech influencer marketing, ... .

----

Revenue:

We still have 0% fees. We have roughly $1000-2000 of daily payment volume now, so if we turned on fees up to 5% we'd expect up to $50-100/day in revenue.

We've made 69.82 ETH from all time trading fees, all of which is being swapped to USDC that is used for paying the team and other business costs (AWS credits, ...).

We're continuing to explore options for increasing runway. We are taking our time on this to be sure we land on something fair to the token community and durable for us as a business that wants to grow rapidly.

We aren't planning to sell $Surplus for more runway.

----

We also love feedback from our users, and we shape our priorities around what we hear from you.

Let us know what features you'd like to see on Surplus!

Your best opportunity right now to get new visitors who convert:

- Think about whether people using Claude or ChatGPT might be trying to do something new with these tools that involves your category
- Find out what questions they're actually asking
- Create a page that targets those keywords and clearly explains how your product helps
- These are new queries so when people ask Claude/ChatGPT for guidance there's a chance they'll suggest your product

I asked Claude how to put something I made with Claude Design online and it suggested Vercel because they did exactly this.

I’ve been seeing a lot of slop games made with Claude Fable 5, so I wanted to build something I’d actually enjoy playing.

What better way to celebrate all the new robotics companies shipping this year than a first-person robot simulator where you clean and organize a house?

This was mostly vibe prompted into a small robotics sandbox, but it gave me a whole new appreciation for how difficult robotics actually is. Even in a game, controlling two independent arms in 3D space, lining up grasps, avoiding collisions, and making sure your own body doesn’t knock things over is surprisingly challenging 😆, It looks simple until you play.

Definitely one of the most fun projects I’ve made so far, and I want to keep expanding it. Still on the slop indie stage but the majority people watching this video will quickly forget how creating anything like this was genuinely impossible year ago and I implore you to try to one shot something like this with the models available a year ago.
